Privacy

Processing of
personal data.

Briefly and clearly: what data we obtain from you through the enquiry form, why we need it and how we handle it.

Who processes the data

The controller of personal data is WHITE ELEPHANT s.r.o., IČ 06245676, with its registered office at Kpt. Jaroše 24, Klokoty, 390 03 Tábor (the Čistá řešení brand). You can contact us by email at info@cistareseni.cz or by phone on +420 736 403 795.

What data and why

When you send the enquiry form, we store the data you enter in it yourself: your name, email, phone number if provided, town or village, the selected service, details of the equipment, the text of your message and any files you attach to the enquiry (photos or documentation). We use it solely to deal with your enquiry and for related communication. The legal basis is the negotiation of a contract at your request.

We do not use the data to send marketing communications and do not pass it on to others for their own purposes.

Where the data is stored

Enquiries are stored in a secure Google Firebase (Google Cloud) database in a data centre in the European Union. Google acts here as the processor. Only persons authorised by the controller have access to enquiries, after logging in to the website administration.

How long we keep the data

We keep the data from an enquiry for as long as it takes to deal with it and for the subsequent communication. If the cooperation leads to a contract, further retention is governed by the contract and by law. You can ask for earlier erasure at any time.

Your rights

You have the right to access your data, to have it rectified or erased, to restrict its processing, to data portability and to object. Simply write to us at info@cistareseni.cz. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.gov.cz).

Cookies and visitor statistics

The website does not use advertising or analytics cookies and does not embed third-party tracking code. We count visits only as anonymous daily totals of page views, without storing anything on your device and without any data that could identify you. Browsers set to “Do Not Track” are not counted.
